verdict.rationale: Running embedded or as a local instance is a fair deployment question for a vector/search database, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only multi-tenant, single-tenant and BYOC cloud deployments on object storage, accessed via SDK clients. Nothing shows an in-process embedded mode or a lightweight local instance. Isolated per-test namespaces are a related testing practice on the hosted service, not a local deployment mode, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the database embedded in-process or as a lightweight local instance for development and small workloads
